![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyNDIyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a933401125a79a3d07562b86d1bb5f492a5862a/image.png)

Ο διαγωνισμός **WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 A (13/6)** θα γινει την πρώτη μέρα της διπλής διοργάνωσης και θα φέρει δυνατές προκλήσεις για τους λάτρεις των μεγαλύτερων και πιο απαιτητικών cubes! 🔥 Το πρόγραμμα περιλαμβάνει τα αγωνίσματα **3x3, 5x5, 6x6 και square-1**, δίνοντας την ευκαιρία στους συμμετέχοντες να δοκιμάσουν τις ικανότητές τους σε μια ποικιλία από events που απαιτούν τόσο ταχύτητα όσο και αντοχή.

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Α μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. 

Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 5x5
* 6x6
* 7x7
* Square-1

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

The **WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 A (13/6)** competition will take place on the first day of the double event and will bring strong challenges for lovers of the biggest and most demanding cubes! 🔥 The schedule includes the **3x3, 5x5, 6x6, and square-1** events, giving participants the opportunity to test their skills in a variety of events that require both speed and endurance.

Note: This competition is **Part A** of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **ONLY one of the two**.

Competition Α events:
* 3x3
* 5x5
* 6x6
* 7x7
* Square-1

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1OTI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f0650ca58223b353bab20a452b3dca7389995219/CaminosCelaya.jpg)

***🎵"“Tú y las nubes me traen muy loco, Tú y las nubes me van a matar, Yo pa' arriba, volteo muy poco, Tú pa' abajo, no sabes mirar”..."🎶***

El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música.

Te esperamos en Celaya para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/



The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music.

We look forward to seeing you in Celaya to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

# REGISTRO
### ATENÇÃO: Faça o registro no site MeuSESI para ter acesso às dependências do SESI. Você pode se cadastrar [clicando aqui](https://meusesi.sesisp.org.br/Reserva/0ee4eb94-ec6f-4490-b47e-08dea9de73cd)

**A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:**
* Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
* Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
* Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$15,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**
* Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: Alunos e Associados do SESI estão isentos da taxa de insrição, mas devem Informar que são alunos do SESI no campo INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS durante o ato da inscrição.
# REGISTRATION
### ATTENTION: Register on the MeuSESI website to access SESI facilities. You can register by [clicking here](https://meusesi.sesisp.org.br/Reserva/0ee4eb94-ec6f-4490-b47e-08dea9de73cd)

**The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:**
* Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
* Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
* Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$15,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**
* For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: SESI students and associates are exempt from the registration fee, but they must inform that they are SESI students in the ADDITIONAL INFORMATION field during registration.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--580e15233f5c8e3065f8116ca9163a7eba4d3743/Picture1.png)
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2026#74815-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2026#74814-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2026#74815-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UhseoOsong2026#74814-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
